result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.personalized_pagerank()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Calculate Personalized PageRank with a custom restart distribution. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L17905-L18001){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.personalized_pagerank( personalization, damping=0.85, max_iter=100, tol=1e-06, attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Unlike standard PageRank where the random surfer teleports uniformly to any node, Personalized PageRank teleports back to seed nodes with probabilities given by `personalization`. This makes it the primary method for gene prioritization in genome-wide association studies (GWAS): seed nodes are GWAS hits, and the resulting scores rank candidate genes by network proximity to those hits. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [personalization]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [dict[int, float]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Dictionary mapping node IDs to restart probabilities. Values are normalized internally, so they don't need to sum to 1. Nodes not in the dictionary have zero restart probability. [damping]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[0.85]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Probability of following an edge (vs. teleporting back to a seed). Higher values let the walk spread further from the seeds. Typical range: `0.5`-`0.95`. [max_iter]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[100]{.dv}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Maximum number of power-iteration steps. [tol]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[1e-06]{.fl}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Convergence tolerance (L1 norm of rank change between iterations). [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Column name for storing scores in the node DataFrame. Defaults to `"personalized_pagerank"`. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns the score dictionary. If `False` (default), stores scores in the node DataFrame and returns self for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Union[dict[int, float], Graph]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict` is `True`: dictionary mapping node IDs to scores (sum to `1.0`). Otherwise returns self. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Prioritize nodes reachable from a single seed: ::: {#207e8183 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph(directed=True) .add_node(label="GeneA") .add_node(label="GeneB") .add_node(label="GeneC") .add_node(label="GeneD") .add_edge("GeneA", "GeneB") .add_edge("GeneB", "GeneC") .add_edge("GeneC", "GeneD") .add_edge("GeneA", "GeneD") ) seed_id = graph.get_id_from_label("GeneA") scores = graph.personalized_pagerank( personalization={seed_id: 1.0}, return_dict=True, ) {graph.get_label_from_id(nid): round(s, 4) for nid, s in scores.items()} ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {'GeneC': 0.1434, 'GeneA': 0.3971, 'GeneD': 0.2907, 'GeneB': 0.1688} ``` ::: :::
